_comment: New Hampshire 2027-2028 QAP (NH Housing, HFA 109), effective 2026-03-16. Scoring is HFA 109.07. Page numbers are PHYSICAL PDF pages, which here equal the printed page numbers.

qap_updates.notes: NH states NO maximum total score anywhere in HFA 109.07, so computed totals cannot be reconciled against the document. Adopted in 2026 but governs the 2027-2028 rounds. Includes negative-point categories (cost overruns, developer non-compliance) which are excluded from the positive total.

criteria.note: TWO pick-one scales that stack: the firm-commitment scale awards 'additional points', so the maximum is 22 + 14 = 36. This is the single largest scoring category in the NH QAP - larger than General Occupancy, Supportive Housing, or Location - which is worth confirming in review.
